trust_decision.summary: MISMATCH: the advisory describes shell expansion of the connection string in the Launch MongoDB Shell terminal, but the listed fix only changes how the confirmation modal displays the redacted connection string (line wrapping, so Windows does not ellipsize it). The shell-side protections (quoted env-var references for every shell branch, rejecting quotes and newlines) are already present at the pinned commit. The only trust decision the fix touches is the user's confirmation of the destination connection string in a modal.

landing_point.why: The summary names shell expansion in the Launch MongoDB Shell terminal. sendText of the shell command with the env-var reference is where an engineer would look first, but it is already quoted at the pinned commit.

fix_sites.entry_point: VS Code command mdb.launchShell (src/mdbExtensionController.ts:475-478) via src/commands/launchMongoShell.ts:123; also mdb.connectWithUri, including deep links, via src/connectionController.ts:277
new exported helper formatConnectionStringForDisplay (fix.diff:100-129), only reached through confirmConnection

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The fix is cosmetic modal formatting. A solver told the problem is command injection would see the already-quoted shell paths and could fairly say there is nothing left to fix.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The modal must keep credentials redacted and must keep every query option (for example proxyHost) visible. A solver who drops redaction, or who rejects long or multi-host strings, breaks legitimate connects and shell launches.

O6_input_shapes: connection string with credentials (scheme and credentials on their own line)
multi-host seed list (one host per line)
unparseable string (falls back to redacted only)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new shell branch (for example fish, nushell or WSL) that interpolates the connection string unquoted or uses a different variable syntax
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Shell detection is a substring if-chain on vscode.env.shell, and maintainers have added branches one at a time with per-shell quoting.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a character denylist that misses a shell-specific metacharacter (for example the backtick in PowerShell, or %/! in cmd)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The denylist only covers quotes and line breaks, and the comment at src/commands/launchMongoShell.ts:38-40 shows per-shell reasoning a maintainer could get wrong in one branch.

O9_family: OS command injection (CWE-78) per the advisory; the fix itself is UI misrepresentation of a confirmation dialog (CWE-451-like)

O10_build.toolchain: Node/npm, VS Code extension test harness (@vscode/test-electron, mocha, sinon)
services: VS Code Electron test host (the suite stubs vscode.window)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add more escaping or a stricter character denylist in launchMongoShell.ts, which has nothing to do with the modal-display change the hidden tests check.

out_of_scope_notes: The actual shell-quoting fixes (e6c5419 VSCODE-796, and the earlier quote/newline rejection) are ancestors of the pinned commit, not this fix.
unverified: Advisory-to-commit mapping: the fix commit message (VSCODE-820, modal wrapping) does not match the CVE summary; the advisory may cite the wrong commit.
Whether the VS Code test host runs headless offline after the build (needs_gpu_kernel_gui is flagged because the tests need an Electron/VS Code instance, usually under xvfb); not checked.
